entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A powerful spell the Founder Dragons used to create Strixhaven and safeguard it, holding the power of the five elder dragons.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: University on Arcavios created with the Invocation.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The five dragons who created Strixhaven.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who burned through Strixhaven's defenses.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: Professor who tasked the students to find the Invocation and led the survivors.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Student who powered the invocation with his life and whose planeswalker spark ignited.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Student sent to find the Invocation.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: Student who was distracted by Nassari.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: Student who chronicled the flora in the invocation.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: Student whose portion bound the parts together.

entities.name: Dean Nassari
entities.description: Dean with an elemental body, restored by the Invocation.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven library where the Invocation was found.

events.summary: Professor Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
events.quote: Professor Vess tasked a small group of surviving students

events.summary: The students find the living Invocation and learn it must be read together in five parts.
events.quote: They realized that they had to follow the elder dragons' example and read all five parts together.

events.summary: Rootha is distracted by Nassari's arrival and Quint pours his own life into the spell to power it.
events.quote: he poured magic directly into Rootha's petal and powered the invocation with his life alone

events.summary: The spell obliterates the main Phyrexian wave and restores Nassari's elemental body.
events.quote: the main wave of compleated professors and other Phyrexians was obliterated by the spell

events.summary: Quint's planeswalker spark ignites and he is transported to another plane.

relations.quote: originally used to create the University of Strixhaven on Arcavios

relations.note: led the surviving students and deans
relations.quote: regroup under the leadership of Professor Vess
